common_dependency.note: Structural centres keep the 16 September Generic Ballot; only local poll aggregates are refreshed.

limits: Probabilities are conditional on the modelled pair in each race; third parties, ranked-choice transfers and runoffs are not simulated.
A candidate outside the modelled pair is bounded by the polls (third_candidate_check per race).
Structural centres keep the 16 September Generic Ballot; local poll aggregates are refreshed daily from secondary sources.
Calibration horizon T-47 is applied to the current snapshot.
Independent caucus choices are scenarios, not forecasts.
